en.s: The Battle of the Orontes was fought on 15 September 994 between the Byzantines and their Hamdanid allies under Michael Bourtzes against the forces of the Fatimid vizier of Damascus, the Turkish general Manjutakin. The battle was a Fatimid victory.

zh.s: 奥龙特斯河战役发生于994年9月15日，交战双方是由迈克尔·布尔特泽斯率领的拜占庭军队及其哈姆丹王朝盟军，以及大马士革法蒂玛王朝维齐尔麾下、由突厥将领曼朱塔金指挥的部队。法蒂玛军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Caravaggio was fought near Caravaggio, in Lombardy (northern Italy), between the armies of the Ambrosian Republic (Milan's short lived republic) and the Republic of Venice, on 15 September 1448. The commander of the Milanese army was the condottiero Francesco Sforza, who later, with the help of the same Venetian armies, would conquer Milan and establish himself as its duke.

zh.s: 卡拉瓦乔战役于1448年9月15日在意大利北部伦巴第的卡拉瓦乔附近爆发，交战双方是米兰短暂成立的安布罗西亚共和国和威尼斯共和国。米兰军队由佣兵统帅弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎指挥。后来，他在威尼斯军队的帮助下征服米兰，并成为米兰公爵。

en.s: The siege of Deventer was a siege of Deventer (then a major Hanseatic city) in 1456 during a struggle between Duke Philip the Good of Burgundy and the church, the nobility, and cities of the Oversticht (Overijssel) that included Kampen, Zwolle and Deventer.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1456年，勃艮第公爵菲利普三世与奥弗赖瑟尔地区的教会、贵族和城镇发生冲突期间，德芬特遭到围攻。当时德芬特是一座重要的汉萨同盟城市；坎彭、兹沃勒和德芬特等城市都位于该地区。

en.s: The Ottoman conquest of Lesbos took place in September 1462. The Ottoman Empire, under Sultan Mehmed II, laid siege to the island's capital, Mytilene. After its surrender, the other forts of the island surrendered as well. The event put an end to the semi-independent Genoese lordship that the Gattilusio family had established in the northeastern Aegean since the mid-14th century, and heralded the beginning of the First Ottoman–Venetian War in the following year.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 奥斯曼帝国征服莱斯沃斯岛
zh.s: 奥斯曼帝国于1462年9月征服莱斯沃斯岛。穆罕默德二世苏丹率军围攻该岛首府米蒂利尼。首府投降后，岛上其他要塞也相继投降。这场征服结束了加蒂卢西奥家族自14世纪中叶起在爱琴海东北部建立的半独立热那亚领地，也预示着次年第一次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Vistula Lagoon (Polish: Bitwa na Zalewie Wiślanym or Polish: Bitwa w Zatoce Świeżej) was fought on September 15, 1463 between the navy of the Teutonic Order, and the navy of the Prussian Confederation which was allied with the King of Poland, as part of the Thirteen Years' War.

zh.s: 维斯瓦河潟湖海战（波兰语：Bitwa na Zalewie Wiślanym或Bitwa w Zatoce Świeżej）发生于1463年9月15日。交战双方是条顿骑士团海军，以及与波兰国王结盟的普鲁士联盟海军。此战属于十三年战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Ohrid (Albanian: Beteja e Ohrit) took place on 14 or 15 September 1464 between Albanian ruler Skanderbeg's forces and Ottoman forces. A crusade against Sultan Mehmed II had been planned by Pope Pius II with Skanderbeg as one of its main leaders. The battle near Ohrid occurred as a result of an Albanian incursion into Ottoman territory.

zh.s: 奥赫里德战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Ohrit）发生于1464年9月14日或15日，交战双方是阿尔巴尼亚统治者斯坎德培的军队和奥斯曼军队。教宗庇护二世曾计划发动十字军东征讨伐苏丹穆罕默德二世，斯坎德培是主要领导者之一。阿尔巴尼亚军队入侵奥斯曼领土，引发了奥赫里德附近的这场战斗。

en.s: The siege of Lochem also known as the Relief of Lochem was a siege that took place in the Dutch city of Lochem during the Eighty Years' War. The city was relieved by a States army under Count Philip of Hohenlohe-Neuenstein and William Louis of Nassau-Dillenburg and John Norreys on September 24, 1582. This marked the end of the Spanish siege of the city by the Spanish general Francisco Verdugo.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 洛赫姆围城战又称洛赫姆解围战，是八十年战争期间发生在荷兰洛赫姆市的一场围城战。1582年9月24日，菲利普·冯·霍恩洛厄-诺伊恩施泰因伯爵、拿骚-迪伦堡的威廉·路易和约翰·诺里斯率领的联省军解除了围城，结束了西班牙将领弗朗西斯科·维尔杜戈对该城的围困。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Riga (Swedish: Belägringen av Riga; Polish: Oblężenie Rygi) was a successful Swedish siege of Riga during the Polish–Swedish War (1621–1625). It led to the capture of the city, and subsequently sent shockwaves through Europe.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 里加围城战（瑞典语：Belägringen av Riga；波兰语：Oblężenie Rygi）是波兰—瑞典战争（1621—1625）期间瑞典军队对里加发动的一次围城，最终瑞典军队攻占该城。这一消息随后震动欧洲。

en.s: The sack of Cashel, also known as the massacre of Cashel, took place on 15 September 1647 during the Irish Confederate Wars, when Cashel Castle in County Tipperary was taken by a Protestant Parliamentarian army commanded by the Baron of Inchiquin. In what is considered one of the most brutal incidents of the war, survivors of the Catholic garrison were executed along with a number of civilians and the castle was sacked.

zh.s: 卡舍尔城劫掠事件也称卡舍尔大屠杀，发生于1647年9月15日爱尔兰邦联战争期间。英奇奎因男爵率领的新教议会军攻占了蒂珀雷里郡的卡舍尔城堡。此事被视为战争期间最残酷的事件之一：天主教守军的幸存者和一些平民遭到处决，城堡也被洗劫。

en.s: The Peach War, sometimes called the Peach Tree War, was a one-day occupation of New Amsterdam on September 15, 1655, by several hundred Munsee, followed by raids on Staten Island and Pavonia (today's Jersey City). Forty-three colonists were killed and over 100, mostly women and children, were taken captive, but released later. The cause of the Peach War has been the subject of debate.

zh.s: 桃树战争也称桃树之战。1655年9月15日，数百名曼西人占领新阿姆斯特丹一天，随后袭击了斯塔滕岛和帕沃尼亚（今泽西市）。43名殖民者死亡，100多人被俘，其中大多数是妇女和儿童，后来这些俘虏获释。这场战争的起因一直存在争议。

en.s: The siege of Chania in 1660 was an attempt by the Christian forces to recapture the city from the Ottoman hold. The Ottoman managed to thwart the Christian attempt to capture the city.

zh.s: 1660年哈尼亚围城战是基督教军队试图从奥斯曼人手中夺回该城的一次行动。奥斯曼军队挫败了基督教军队的攻城企图。

en.s: The Bremen-Verden campaign (German: Bremen-Verdener feldzug) was a conflict during the Northern Wars in Europe. From 15 September 1675 to 13 August 1676 an anti-Swedish coalition comprising Brandenburg-Prussia, the neighbouring imperial princedoms of Lüneburg and Münster, and Denmark-Norway, conquered the Duchies of Bremen and Verden. Bremen-Verden, a remote outpost of Sweden's Baltic Sea empire, was the third Swedish imperial fief in North Germany granted under the Peace of Westphalia in 1648, alongside Swedish Pomerania and the Barony of Wismar.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 不来梅—费尔登战役（德语：Bremen-Verdener Feldzug）是欧洲北方战争期间的一场冲突。反瑞典联盟由勃兰登堡—普鲁士、邻近的吕讷堡和明斯特帝国诸侯国，以及丹麦—挪威组成，于1675年9月15日至1676年8月13日攻占不来梅和费尔登公国。不来梅—费尔登是瑞典波罗的海帝国的一处偏远领地，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将其授予瑞典，此外瑞典在德国北部还获得了瑞典波美拉尼亚和维斯马男爵领。

en.s: The Battle of Rauge was a battle that took place on 15 September 1701 near Rõuge, Livonia during the Great Northern War. The Swedes won the battle.

zh.s: 劳格战役发生于1701年9月15日，地点在大北方战争期间利沃尼亚的鲁埃附近。瑞典军队赢得了这场战斗。

en.s: The Raid on Quistello was a raid and meeting engagement in which the Austrians encountered the Piedmontese and French during the War of the Polish Succession on 15 September 1734. The military engagement took place in the area between Quistello and San Benedetto Val di Sambro in Emilia-Romagna, northern Italy, on the left bank of the Secchia, about 28 kilometres (17 mi) north of Guastalla.

zh.s: 基斯泰洛突袭战发生于1734年9月15日，是波兰王位继承战争期间奥地利军队与皮埃蒙特、法国军队遭遇的一场突袭战。交战地点在意大利北部艾米利亚-罗马涅大区基斯泰洛与圣贝内代托瓦尔迪桑布罗之间，位于塞基亚河左岸，距瓜斯塔拉以北约28公里（17英里）。

en.s: The Battle of Signal Hill, fought on 15 September 1762, was the last battle of the French and Indian War. A British force under Lieutenant-colonel William Amherst recaptured St. John's, which the French had seized earlier that year in a surprise attack described in some accounts as an ambush.

zh.s: 信号山战役发生于1762年9月15日，是法国和印第安人战争的最后一场战斗。威廉·阿默斯特中校率领的英军重新夺回了圣约翰斯；法国军队此前在当年一次突袭中占领了该地，有些记载称那次行动是伏击。

en.s: The Landing at Kip's Bay was a British amphibious landing during the New York Campaign in the American Revolutionary War on September 15, 1776, occurring on the eastern shore of present-day Manhattan. Heavy advance fire from British naval forces in the East River caused the inexperienced militia guarding the landing area to flee, making it possible for the British to land unopposed at Kip's Bay. Skirmishes in the aftermath of the landing resulted in the British capture of some of those militia. British maneuvers following the landing very nearly cut off the escape route of some Continental Army forces stationed further southeast on the island.

zh.s: 基普斯湾登陆战发生于1776年9月15日，是美国独立战争纽约战役期间英军发动的一次两栖登陆。登陆地点在今天曼哈顿东岸。英军舰艇从东河一侧猛烈炮击，守卫登陆区的民兵缺乏经验，很快逃散，英军因此得以不受阻拦地在基普斯湾登陆。此后的小规模冲突中，英军俘获了一些民兵。登陆后的英军行动还差点切断驻扎在岛屿东南部的一些大陆军部队的撤退路线。

en.t: American Revolutionary War: British forces successfully land at Kip's Bay, forcing the Continental Army, which was already withdrawing from New York City, to cede control of the lower half of Manhattan Island
en.s: The American Revolutionary War (April 19, 1775 – September 3, 1783), also known as the Revolutionary War or American War of Independence or simply the American Revolution, was the armed conflict that comprised the final eight years of the broader American Revolution, in which American Patriot forces organized as the Continental Army and, commanded by George Washington, defeated the British Army.

zh.t: 美国独立战争：英军在基普湾成功登陆，迫使已从纽约市撤退的大陆军放弃曼哈顿岛南部
zh.s: 美国独立战争（1775年4月19日—1783年9月3日）也称革命战争或美国独立战争，是更广泛美国革命最后8年中的武装冲突。乔治·华盛顿指挥的爱国者军队组成大陆军，最终击败英国陆军。

en.s: The action of 15 September 1782 (also known as the Second Battle of Delaware Bay) was a naval action in the mouth of the Delaware Bay in which four Royal Navy vessels under George Elphinstone pursued and attacked three French warships that included two frigates under Louis-René Levassor de Latouche Tréville. The French 38-gun frigate Aigle was grounded and captured along with Tréville.

zh.s: 1782年9月15日海战也称第二次特拉华湾战役，发生在特拉华湾入口处。乔治·埃尔芬斯通率领四艘英国皇家海军舰艇追击并攻击三艘法国军舰，其中包括路易-勒内·德·拉特什·特雷维尔指挥的两艘护卫舰。法国38炮护卫舰“鹰”号搁浅后被俘，特雷维尔也一同被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Sittimungulum (variant spellings include Sattiamungulum, Sathinungulum, Satyamanagalam) was a series of battles and skirmishes fought between 13 and 15 September 1790, during the Third Anglo-Mysore War, in and near the town now known as Sathyamangalam in the southern part of the Sultanate of Mysore. Forces of Mysore's ruler Tipu Sultan very nearly overwhelmed a British East India Company force under the command of Captain John Floyd.

zh.s: 西蒂蒙古卢姆战役也有萨蒂阿蒙古卢姆、萨蒂努古卢姆和萨蒂亚曼加拉姆等拼法，是一系列战斗和小规模交锋，发生于1790年9月13日至15日的第三次英迈索尔战争期间，地点在迈索尔苏丹国南部、今称萨蒂亚曼加拉姆的城镇及其附近。迈索尔统治者蒂普苏丹的军队一度几乎击溃由约翰·弗洛伊德上尉指挥的英国东印度公司部队。

en.s: The 1st Battle of Courtrai took place on 15 September 1793, two days after the Battle of Menin during the Flanders Campaign of the Wars of the French Revolution, fought between a Division of the Nicolas Houchard's French Republican Army of the North under Joseph de Hédouville, and an Austrian force under Johann Beaulieu, supported by a British detachment from the forces of the Duke of York. It resulted in an Allied victory that brought an end to Houchard's campaign, and led directly to his dismissal and subsequent execution.

zh.s: 第一次科特赖克战役发生于1793年9月15日，即梅宁战役两天后，是法国大革命战争中佛兰德斯战役的一部分。法军北方军团的一个师由约瑟夫·德·埃杜维尔指挥，隶属尼古拉·乌沙尔；对手是约翰·博利厄率领的奥军，另有约克公爵麾下的一支英军分队支援。联军获胜，乌沙尔的战役行动因此结束，他随后被解职并遭处决。

en.s: The Battle of Epierre (15 September 1793) was part of a larger War of the First Coalition campaign that pitted a Republican French army led by François Christophe de Kellermann against a Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont army commanded by the Duke of Montferrat. Under the overall leadership of the Austrian commander in chief Joseph Nikolaus De Vins, Montferrat launched an offensive in August 1793 to recapture Savoy from the French. Because the French were preoccupied with the Siege of Lyon, the Piedmontese recovered the Maurienne and Tarentaise Valleys, but they were stopped just short of Albertville and the reconquest of Savoy.

zh.s: 埃皮埃尔战役发生于1793年9月15日，是第一次反法同盟战争中一场更大规模军事行动的一部分。交战双方是弗朗索瓦-克里斯托夫·德·凯勒曼率领的法兰西共和军，以及蒙费拉托公爵指挥的撒丁—皮埃蒙特王国军队。奥军总司令约瑟夫·尼古劳斯·德·温斯统筹指挥。1793年8月，蒙费拉托发动攻势，试图从法国手中夺回萨伏依。法军当时忙于围攻里昂，皮埃蒙特军收复了莫里耶讷和塔朗泰斯山谷，但未能攻下阿尔贝维尔，也没能夺回萨伏依。

en.s: The Battle of Boxtel was fought in the Duchy of Brabant on 14–15 September 1794, during the War of the First Coalition. It was part of the Flanders campaign of 1793–94 in which mainly British, Dutch and Austrian troops had attempted to launch an invasion of France through Flanders. The battle was won by the French troops.

zh.s: 博克斯特尔战役发生于1794年9月14日至15日，是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一场战斗。它属于1793—1794年的佛兰德斯战役。当时主要由英国、荷兰和奥地利军队组成的联军试图经佛兰德斯入侵法国，最终法军赢得了这场战斗。

en.s: The invasion of the Cape Colony, also known as the Battle of Muizenberg (Dutch: Slag om Muizenberg), was a British military expedition launched in 1795 against the Dutch Cape Colony at the Cape of Good Hope. The Cape Colony, established and controlled by the Dutch East India Company in the 17th century, was at the time the only viable South African port for ships making the journey from Europe to the European colonies in the East Indies.

zh.s: 入侵开普殖民地也称穆伊岑贝赫战役（荷兰语：Slag om Muizenberg），是英国于1795年对好望角的荷兰开普殖民地发动的一次军事远征。开普殖民地由荷兰东印度公司于17世纪建立并控制，当时是从欧洲前往东印度群岛欧洲殖民地的船只在南非唯一可用的港口。

en.s: The Battle of Vizagapatam was a minor naval engagement fought in the approaches to Vizagapatam harbour in the Coastal Andhra region of British India on the Bay of Bengal on 15 September 1804 during the Napoleonic Wars. A French squadron under Contre-Admiral Charles-Alexandre Durand Linois in the ship of the line Marengo attacked the British Royal Navy fourth rate ship HMS Centurion and two East Indiaman merchant ships anchored in the harbour roads. Linois was engaged in an extended raiding campaign, which had already involved operations in the South China Sea, in the Mozambique Channel, off Ceylon and along the Indian coast of the Bay of Bengal.
en.n: The Royal Collection Trust dates the action to 15 September and identifies the engraving’s 18 September date as an error.

zh.s: 维萨卡帕特南海战是一次小规模海战，于1804年9月15日拿破仑战争期间在孟加拉湾沿岸、英属印度海岸安得拉地区的维萨卡帕特南港外海发生。夏尔-亚历山大·迪朗·利努瓦海军少将乘坐“马伦戈”号战列舰，率领一支法国舰队袭击了停泊在港外的英国皇家海军四等舰“百夫长”号和两艘东印度商船。此前，利努瓦一直在进行一系列远程袭击，行动范围已包括南海、莫桑比克海峡、锡兰近海以及孟加拉湾印度沿岸。
zh.n: 皇家收藏信托基金会将交战日期定为9月15日，并指出版画标注的9月18日是错误日期。

en.s: The Copus massacre is a name given to a skirmish occurring on September 15, 1812, between American settlers and Native Americans on the Ohio frontier during the War of 1812. Reverend James Copus and 3 other settlers died while defending the Copus' settlement near present-day Charles Mill Lake, Ohio. Traditional legend has it that Johnny Appleseed "raced throughout the region warning others of impending attack" after this incident. Consequently, his name is included on the Copus memorial–a monument dedicated in 1882 to Copus and others fallen in similar attacks–the "earliest known monument erected to his memory and legend".

zh.s: “科普斯大屠杀”是对1812年战争期间、1812年9月15日美国俄亥俄边疆地区美国定居者与美洲原住民发生的一场小规模冲突的称呼。詹姆斯·科普斯牧师和另外三名定居者在保卫他们靠近今天俄亥俄州查尔斯磨坊湖的聚居地时死亡。当地传说称，事件发生后，约翰尼·阿普尔西德“赶遍这一带，提醒人们即将遭到袭击”。因此，他的名字也被刻在科普斯纪念碑上。纪念碑于1882年建成，纪念科普斯及其他在类似袭击中遇难的人；它被称为“目前所知最早为纪念他本人及相关传说而建的纪念碑”。

en.s: The Eight Trigrams uprising of 1813 (Chinese: 癸酉之變) broke out in China under the Qing dynasty. The rebellion was started by some elements of the millenarian Tianli Sect (天理教) or Heavenly Principle Sect, which was a branch of the White Lotus Sect. Led by Lin Qing (林清; 1770–1813) and Li Wencheng, the revolt occurred in the Zhili, Shandong, and Henan provinces of China. In 1812, the leaders of the Eight Trigram Sect (Bagua jiao) also known as the Sect of Heavenly Order (Tianli jiao) announced that leader Li Wencheng was a 'true lord of the Ming' and declared 1813 as the year for rebellion, while Lin Qing declared himself the reincarnation of Maitreya, the prophesied future Buddha in Buddhism, using banners with the inscription "Entrusted by Heaven to Prepare the Way", a reference to the popular novel Water Margin. They considered him sent by the Eternal Unborn Mother of esoteric Chinese religions, to remove the Qing dynasty whom they regarded as having lost the Mandate of Heaven to rule. The third leader was Feng Keshan, who was called the "King of Earth", Li titled the "King of Men", and Lin referred to as "King of Heaven". The group won support from several powerful eunuchs in the Forbidden City. On 15 September 1813, the group attacked the imperial palace in Beijing.

zh.s: 1813年八卦教起义（中文名：癸酉之变）发生在清朝时期，由天理教（也称天理会，属白莲教支派）中的部分成员发动。起义由林清（1770—1813）和李文成领导，战事蔓延到直隶、山东和河南。1812年，八卦教领袖宣布李文成为“真明主”，并定1813年为起义之年；林清则自称为弥勒转世，打出“奉天开道”的旗号，呼应小说《水浒传》。他们认为林清受中国秘教所信奉的无生老母派遣，要推翻失去天命的清朝。该组织还获得紫禁城中几名有权势太监的支持。1813年9月15日，起义军袭击了北京皇宫。

en.t: Act of Independence of Central America

en.s: The 1885 North-West Territories election was the first major election in the history of the territory. On 15 September 1885, 11 members were elected in separate elections or by acclamation. The elections saw members acclaimed and elected in various electoral districts to the 1st Council of the North-West Territories. The elections were held to elect members to new districts, created to cope with rapid growth of settlers in the NWT at the time.

en.s: The Garza Revolution, or the Garza War, was an armed conflict fought in the Mexican state of Coahuila and the American state of Texas between 1891 and 1893. It began when the revolutionary Catarino Garza launched a campaign into Mexico from Texas to start an uprising against the dictator Porfirio Díaz. Because of this violation of neutrality, the United States Army became involved and assisted the Mexican Army in tracking down Garza's followers.

en.s: The Battle of Pyongyang (Japanese: 平壌作戦) was the second major land battle of the First Sino-Japanese War. It took place on 15 September 1894 in Pyongyang, Korea between the forces of Meiji Japan and Qing China. It is sometimes referred to archaically in western sources as the “Battle of Ping-yang”.Between 13,000 and 15,000 Chinese troops of the Beiyang Army had arrived in Pyongyang on 4 August 1894, and had made extensive repairs to its ancient city walls, feeling itself secure in its superior numbers and in the strength of the defenses.

zh.s: 平壤战役（日语：平壌作戦）是甲午战争中的第二场重大战役，发生于1894年9月15日，交战双方是平壤的明治日本军队和清军。西方旧文献有时称之为“平阳战役”。1894年8月4日，1.3万至1.5万名清朝北洋军士兵抵达平壤，对古城墙进行了大规模修缮。他们认为自己兵力占优、防御坚固，因此可以高枕无忧。

en.s: The 1910 South African general election was held for the 121 seats in the House of Assembly of the Union of South Africa, on 15 September 1910. en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 15 September 1934. All 74 seats in the House of Representatives, and 18 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent United Australia Party led by Prime Minister of Australia Joseph Lyons with coalition partner the Country Party led by Earle Page defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by James Scullin. Labor's share of the primary vote fell to an even lower number than in the 1931 election due to the Lang Labor split, but it was able to pick up an extra four seats on preferences and therefore improve on its position.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1934年9月15日举行联邦大选，改选众议院全部74个席位，以及参议院36个席位中的18席。时任总理约瑟夫·莱昂斯领导的联合澳大利亚党与厄尔·佩吉领导的乡村党组成联盟，击败了由詹姆斯·斯卡林领导的反对党澳大利亚工党。受兰工党分裂影响，工党的初选得票率比1931年还低，但凭借偏好票增加了四席，改善了议会席位状况。

en.s: The Battle of Guadarrama (Spanish: Batalla de Guadarrama), also known as the Battle of Somosierra (Batalla de Somosierra), was a battle that occurred in the Sierra de Guadarrama during the Spanish Civil War from 22 July to 15 September 1936. The Nationalists sent by Emilio Mola attempted to cross the mountain passes of the Sierra de Guadarrama to advance on the capital city of Madrid from the north.

en.s: The Battle of Britain Day is the name given to the large-scale aerial battle that took place on 15 September 1940, during the Battle of Britain (German: Luftschlacht um England or Luftschlacht um Großbritannien). In June 1940, Nazi Germany had conquered most of Western Europe and Scandinavia. At that time, the only major power standing in the way of a German-dominated Europe was the British Empire and the Commonwealth. After having several peace offers rejected by the British, Adolf Hitler ordered the Luftwaffe to destroy the Royal Air Force (RAF) in order to gain air superiority or air supremacy as a prelude to launching Operation Sea Lion, an amphibious assault by the Wehrmacht (German armed forces) onto the British mainland.

zh.s: “不列颠之战日”是对1940年9月15日一场大规模空战的称呼。这场战斗发生在不列颠之战期间，德语称为Luftschlacht um England或Luftschlacht um Großbritannien。1940年6月，纳粹德国征服了西欧和斯堪的纳维亚的大部分地区，当时，阻止欧洲被德国主宰的唯一主要力量是大英帝国及其英联邦成员。英国拒绝了德国提出的多项和平方案后，阿道夫·希特勒命令德国空军摧毁英国皇家空军，以取得制空权，为德军发动海狮行动、两栖入侵英国本土铺路。

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 15 September 1940. The Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party, winning 134 of the 230 seats in the Second Chamber of the Riksdag. It is one of two general elections in Swedish history where a single party received more than half of the vote (the other occasion being 1968).

en.s: The 1943 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on September 15, 1943. The governing Liberals of Premier J. Walter Jones lost seven seats to the Progressive Conservatives led by former Premier William J.P. MacMillan, but were able to retain a strong majority in the Legislature.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1943年9月15日举行大选。首相J.沃尔特·琼斯领导的执政自由党失去七席，输给由前首相威廉·J.P.麦克米伦领导的进步保守党，但仍在省议会保住了稳固多数。

en.s: The Battle of the Vosges and Alsace was a series of battles fought from September 15, 1944, to February 15, 1945, in the Vosges Mountains and the Alsace region during World War II. The engagements involved Free French and American forces advancing against German defenses established in the mountainous region.

zh.s: 孚日山脉与阿尔萨斯战役是第二次世界大战期间的一系列战斗，发生于1944年9月15日至1945年2月15日，战场位于孚日山脉和阿尔萨斯地区。自由法国军队和美军向德军在山区建立的防线推进，双方在此交战。

en.s: The Battle of Gemmano took place during World War II, between 4 September and 15 September 1944. The battle occurred in the area of the Gothic Line, near the Apennine Mountains in northern Italy, which would soon turn out to be the last line of defence for the Axis powers in Italy.

zh.s: 杰马诺战役发生于第二次世界大战期间，战事从1944年9月4日持续到9月15日。战场位于意大利北部亚平宁山脉附近的哥特防线一带；不久后，这里成为轴心国在意大利的最后一道防线。

en.s: Operation Paravane was a British air raid of World War II that inflicted heavy damage on the German battleship Tirpitz, at anchor in Kaafjord in the far north of German-occupied Norway. The attack was conducted on 15 September 1944 by 21 Royal Air Force heavy bombers, which flew from an airfield in the north of the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 帕拉瓦内行动是第二次世界大战期间英国发动的一次空袭，对停泊在纳粹德国占领的挪威最北部科菲尤尔的德国战列舰“提尔皮茨”号造成严重破坏。1944年9月15日，21架英国皇家空军重型轰炸机从苏联北部一处机场起飞，执行了这次空袭。

en.s: Operation Tanne Ost ("Fir East") was a German operation during World War II to capture the island Suursaari (Swedish: Hogland; Russian: Гогланд, romanized: Gogland) in the Gulf of Finland before it could fall into Soviet hands. Suursaari was especially important because it worked as a lock in the Finnish Gulf guarding the minefields keeping the Soviet Baltic Fleet in Kronstadt.

zh.s: 东杉行动（“东部冷杉”）是第二次世界大战期间德国发动的一次行动，目标是在苏军占领前夺取芬兰湾的苏尔萨里岛。该岛对德国尤为重要，因为它像一道闸门，守着芬兰湾里用于阻挡苏联波罗的海舰队进入喀琅施塔得的雷区。

en.s: The Battle of Peleliu, codenamed Operation Stalemate II by the US military, was fought between the United States and Japan during the Mariana and Palau Islands campaign of World War II, from 15 September to 27 November 1944, on the island of Peleliu. US marines of the 1st Marine Division and then soldiers of the US Army's 81st Infantry Division fought to capture an airfield on the small coral island of Peleliu.

en.s: The Battle of Nancy in September 1944 was a 10-day battle on the Western Front of World War II in which the Third United States Army defeated German forces defending the approaches to Nancy, France and crossings over the Moselle River to the north and south of the city. The battle resulted in U.S. forces fighting their way across the Moselle and liberating Nancy.

en.t: Establishment of People's Republic of Bulgaria
en.s: The People's Republic of Bulgaria (PRB; Bulgarian: Народна република България, НРБ, romanized: Narodna republika Bŭlgariya, NRB; pronounced [nɐˈrɔdnɐ rɛˈpublikɐ bɐɫˈɡarijɐ]) was the Bulgarian state that existed from 1946 to 1990, ruled by the Bulgarian Communist Party (BCP; Bulgarian: Българска комунистическа партия (БКП)) together with its coalition partner, the Bulgarian Agrarian People's Union. Bulgaria was also part of Comecon as well as a member of the Warsaw Pact.

zh.t: 保加利亚人民共和国成立
zh.s: 保加利亚人民共和国（PRB；保加利亚语：Народна република България，НРБ，转写：Narodna republika Bŭlgariya，简称NRB）是1946年至1990年存在的保加利亚国家，由保加利亚共产党（BCP）及其联合执政伙伴保加利亚农业人民联盟统治。保加利亚也是经互会成员和华沙条约组织成员。

en.s: The 1949 IFA Shield final was the 56th final of the IFA Shield, the second oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 15 September 1949 at the Calcutta Ground in Kolkata. East Bengal won the final 2–0 to claim their 3rd IFA Shield title. Pansanttom Venkatesh and Ahmed Khan scored the two goals as East Bengal lifted their third IFA Shield title.

en.s: The Battle of Inchon (Korean: 인천 상륙 작전; Hanja: 仁川上陸作戰; MR: Inch'ŏn sangnyuk chakchŏn), also called the Inchon landings, was an amphibious invasion and battle of the Korean War that resulted in a decisive victory and strategic reversal in favor of the United Nations Command. The operation involved some 75,000 troops and 261 naval vessels and led to the recapture of the South Korean capital of Seoul two weeks later. The code name for the Incheon operation was Operation Chromite. The battle began on 15 September 1950 and ended on 19 September.

zh.s: 仁川登陆战（韩语：인천 상륙 작전；汉字：仁川上陸作戰），也称仁川登陆，是朝鲜战争期间的一次两栖入侵和战役，为联合国军司令部带来决定性胜利并扭转了战略局势。行动投入约7.5万名士兵和261艘舰船，两周后收复了韩国首都首尔。仁川行动的代号是“铬铁行动”。战斗于1950年9月15日开始，9月19日结束。

en.t: 8th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 8th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in two sessions, the first 15–27 September 1956 and the second 5–23 May 1958 in Beijing. It was the first Congress of the Chinese Communist Party since the start of it taking full control of mainland China in 1949 and establishing the People's Republic of China.

en.s: A federal election was held in West Germany on 15 September 1957 to elect the members of the third Bundestag. The Christian Democratic Union and its longtime ally, the Christian Social Union in Bavaria, won a sweeping victory, taking 270 seats in the Bundestag to win the first–and, to date, only–absolute majority for a single German parliamentary group in a free election.

zh.s: 西德于1957年9月15日举行联邦大选，选出第三届联邦议院议员。基督教民主联盟及其长期盟友巴伐利亚基督教社会联盟大获全胜，在联邦议院赢得270席。这是自由选举中单一德国议会党团首次、也是迄今唯一一次获得绝对多数。

en.s: The Newark Bay rail accident occurred on September 15, 1958 in Newark Bay, New Jersey. A Central Railroad of New Jersey (CRRNJ) morning commuter train, #3314, ran through a restrictive and a stop signal, derailed, and slid off the open Newark Bay lift bridge. Both diesel locomotives and the first two coaches plunged into Newark Bay and sank immediately, killing 48 people. A third coach, snagged by its rear truck (bogie), hung precariously off the lift bridge for two hours before it also toppled into the water. As the locomotive crew was killed, the cause of the accident was not determined, but a medical emergency in the cab was theorized.

zh.s: 纽瓦克湾铁路事故发生于1958年9月15日，地点在新泽西州纽瓦克湾。新泽西中央铁路公司一列编号3314的早间通勤列车越过限速信号和停车信号后脱轨，从开启状态的纽瓦克湾升降桥上滑落。两台柴油机车和前两节车厢坠入纽瓦克湾，随即沉没，造成48人死亡。第三节车厢的后转向架卡住桥体，悬在桥边两小时后也坠入水中。机车乘务员全部遇难，事故原因未能查明；有人推测驾驶室内发生了突发疾病。

en.s: Terrorism in France refers to the terrorist attacks that have targeted the country and its population during the 20th and 21st centuries. Terrorism, in this case is much related to the country's history, international affairs and political approach. Legislation has been set up by lawmakers to fight terrorism in France. en.s: The 16th Street Baptist Church bombing was an act of white supremacist terrorism which occurred at the African-American 16th Street Baptist Church in Birmingham, Alabama on Sunday, September 15, 1963, when four members of the Ku Klux Klan planted at least 15 sticks of dynamite attached to a timing device beneath the front steps of the church. Described by Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. as "one of the most vicious and tragic crimes ever perpetrated against humanity", the explosion at the church killed four girls and injured 22 others.

zh.t: 第16街浸信会教堂爆炸案
zh.s: 第16街浸信会教堂爆炸案是白人至上主义者发动的恐怖袭击，发生于1963年9月15日星期日，地点在阿拉巴马州伯明翰一座非裔美国人教堂。四名三K党成员在教堂前门台阶下放置了至少15根连接定时装置的炸药。马丁·路德·金博士称此案是“人类历史上最残暴、最悲惨的罪行之一”。爆炸造成四名女孩死亡，另有22人受伤。

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 15 September 1968. Held in the wake of the crushing of the Prague spring, it resulted in a landslide victory for the Social Democratic government and Prime Minister Tage Erlander. It is one of two general elections in Swedish history where a single party received more than half of the vote (the other being the election of 1940). Erlander would resign the following year after an uninterrupted tenure of 23 years as head of government. The Social Democrats had held the office of Prime Minister since 1932 except a three-month "holiday cabinet" in 1936.

zh.s: 瑞典于1968年9月15日举行大选。布拉格之春遭镇压后，社会民主党政府和首相塔格·埃兰德取得压倒性胜利。这是瑞典历史上仅有的两次单一政党得票超过半数的大选之一，另一次是1940年大选。埃兰德连续执政23年后于次年辞职。自1932年以来，社会民主党一直执政，只有1936年出现过一次为期三个月的“假期内阁”。

en.s: The 1968 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the 37th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1968 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Cork scored two early goals but Wexford let 3-1 to 2-0 at half-time. Both sides had the benefit of long puck-outs taken by their respective full-backs. Wexford won their first ever title by a three-point margin.

zh.t: 1968年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉球锦标赛决赛

en.s: The 1974 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final, the 43rd event of its type, is the culmination of the 1974 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship. en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 15 September 1991. The Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in the Riksdag, winning 138 of the 349 seats. The election was notable due to the rise of a new right-wing populist party named New Democracy which succeeded in securing a parliamentary mandate for the first (and last) time. The four parties of the centre-right coalition (the Centre Party, Liberal People's Party, Moderate Party, and Christian Democratic Society Party) were allocated a combined total of 171 seats, 17 more than the two left-wing parties' 154, but still less than the 175 necessary for a majority.

en.s: The 1994 Liberian coup attempt was a failed coup d'état in Liberia by dissident elements of the Armed Forces of Liberia (AFL), led by General Charles Julu, against the Liberian National Transitional Government (LNTG), during the First Liberian Civil War. en.s: Malaysia Airlines Flight 2133 (MH2133/MAS2133) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight that crashed due to pilot error on 15 September 1995, taking the lives of 32 of the 49 passengers and 2 of the 4 crew, 34 in all. en.s: The Gleision Colliery mining accident was a mining accident which occurred on 15 September 2011 at the Gleision Colliery, a drift mine at Cilybebyll in Neath Port Talbot, in Wales. The accident occurred while seven miners were working with explosives on a narrow coal seam. Following a routine blasting operation the tunnel in which the miners were working began to fill with water. Three of the miners escaped, with one being taken to hospital with life-threatening injuries, while the others were trapped underground. A search and rescue operation was launched to locate the four remaining miners, but they were found deceased the following day.

en.s: The Bahrain–Israel normalization agreement, officially Abraham Accords: Declaration of Peace, Cooperation, and Constructive Diplomatic and Friendly Relations, is an agreement to normalize diplomatic and other relations between Bahrain and Israel.
